contactId.title: Verified Contact Id
contactId.description: Store in the agent variable. Never read a Salesforce Id aloud.

message.title: Message
message.description: Say this in customer-friendly language. Confirm their details were saved, then ask for trip details.

nextAction.title: Next Action
nextAction.description: If CREATE_BOOKING, collect trip details next. Do not amend, cancel, or rebook yet.

success.title: Success
success.description: If false, say Message and do not continue to Create Booking.
